description: OMEGAlpes constructs linear and mixed-integer models for energy-system sizing, dispatch, flexibility and multi-actor analysis. Its provider factsheet describes Python inputs and several solver options. The provider is G2Elab. Coverage: The documented version 0.4.1 targets local and community electricity and heat systems. Time resolution and study horizons depend on the user’s model. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The provider factsheet states Apache 2.0. Commercial and free external solvers have their own terms. Limitations: The factsheet is version-specific and does not establish the latest release. Model assumptions and numerical results were not tested. For simulation it supports energy-design trade-offs and flexibility studies. Related resources: model-oemof-solph is a related optimisation tool; no direct implementation relationship was established.
